name: Land Ho!
summary: At Faldir's Cove, Lolo warns you that Captain O'Breen's brief stop may last far longer than planned. The Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden's Folly are lost, and Lolo directs you to the captain.

sections.title: Lolo's Welcome
sections.body:
Lolo greets you at Faldir's Cove and tells you what has gone wrong. Captain O'Breen promised the crew only a few hours ashore to gather treasure before sailing back to Booty Bay. Lolo doubts they will be away so briefly.

The Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden's Folly, two ships in the formation, now lie on the sea floor. If you mean to stay, Lolo says to speak with the captain.

sections.title: The Captain's Account
sections.body:
Captain O'Breen fears Seahorn will take the ship if word of the disaster spreads. A contraption belonging to the Professor pointed toward lost treasure near Faldir's Cove. So the Harbinger docked there and signaled the other two ships to follow.

Then the sea rumbled and the water drew back. Both ships struck the reef. O'Breen says it is no ordinary reef, and something lies below. He promises handsome payment to anyone who helps the crew.

faq.q: What happened to the other ships?
faq.answer: The Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden's Folly were lost and now lie on the sea floor.

faq.q: Why did the crew come to Faldir's Cove?
faq.answer: Captain O'Breen brought the crew to Faldir's Cove to gather treasure. They expected to stay only a few hours before sailing back to Booty Bay.

faq.q: Who should you talk to at Faldir's Cove?
faq.answer: Lolo the lookout suggests you speak with Captain O'Breen at Faldir's Cove if you plan to stay.
